english.title: Obstruct PC in exercise of powers conferred by s.7A / 7B or a warrant under s.7C - Prevention of Terrorism 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed a constable in the exercise of a power conferred by

(A)_[section 7A of the Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005 to enter and search premises namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..)]_
(B)_[section 7B of the Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005 to enter and search premises namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..) on a failure to grant access]_
(C)_[section 7C of the Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005 to enter and search premises namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..) in order to monitor compliance with a control order by a warrant]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(3A) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
intentionally obstruct a constable in the exercise of a power conferred by
s.7A Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005 to enter/search premises or
s.7B Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005 to enter/search premises on a failure to grant access OR
s.7C Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005 to enter/search premises
in order to monitor compliance with a control order by a warrant

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Subsection 9(3A) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005 was inserted by section 78(2) of the Counter-Terrorism Act 2008.
(ii) Sections 7A, 7B and 7C. of the Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005 were inserted by section 78(1) of the Counter-Terrorism Act 2008.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Fifty one weeks imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Note:
Summary conviction maximum six months imprisonment until section 281(5) Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force).

Time limit on Prosecutions:
None
